Definition: Tseboim or Tsebijim, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Zeboiim was one of the cities of the plain, named beside Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Bela. Its king went to war with Chedorlaomer, and the cities were overthrown; Moses warns Israel that the land will become like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim. Hosea remembers it when God says He will not give Israel up to the fate of Admah and Zeboiim.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zeboiim is kept in Scripture as a warning — a city named with Sodom, and then named as the fate God refuses for His people. Judgment is real, and so is the mercy that holds it back.
